### 🛒 Current Deals (No Code Needed)
- **Mix & Match Deal** for $6.99 per item, or the **Perfect Combo** with two pizzas, sides, and a drink for just $19.99.
- **Weeklong Carryout** promotion: 1-topping pizzas, 8-piece wings, or boneless chicken for $7.99 each. Carryout only, excludes XL and specialty pizzas.
- **Any 3 Dip Cups for $1.99** at Domino's.
- **Breads & Oven-Baked Dips** starting at just $5.99.
- **Chicken Wings** starting from $6.99.
- **50% off first 3 app orders** for new app users.

---

### 🎓 Student Discount
- Students get an extra sweet deal with **50% off through UNiDAYS**, making pizza night way more affordable.

---

### 🏆 Domino's Rewards Program
- Domino's Rewards members can redeem points for free items at different tiers — **20 points** gets you appetizers, sides, or desserts after just two orders, while **60 points** scores you a free medium 2-topping pizza.
- There's also **Emergency Pizza** — if you place a qualifying delivery order and something goes wrong, you can claim a free medium two-topping pizza within seven days.

---

### 💡 Tips for Saving More
- Signing up for Domino's email and text alerts gets you access to limited-time offers and location-specific deals. These alerts often include current coupon codes and flash sales.
- Following Domino's on social media is one of the easiest ways to catch promo codes, flash deals, and even free food offers that don't always make it to their website.
- The app and the website also price differently on the same order. App-only deals usually beat anything offered through the desktop site, so the cheapest route is to start in the app and check the local Deals tab.
